script.problem: Moment 2's passage Deuteronomy 1:22-25 doesn't include a verse that names Kadesh-barnea in the lessons.

terra.problem: “Only Caleb and Joshua were spared” implies that everyone else died. The passage refers to the men who came out of Egypt and were twenty or older; younger Israelites also survived. Caleb and Joshua wandered with Israel too.
“Caleb remembers Kadesh-barnea” takes place at Gilgal, not at Kadesh-barnea. Replace it with a moment that happens at Kadesh-barnea.
